correctness.rationale: The coefficient space and all rational lines are enumerated exhaustively. Geometric singularities of ternary cubics have a closed point of degree <=3; independent F9/F27 evaluation and Groebner unit-ideal calculations both yield 1872 smooth blocking forms. Generator traversal proves one PGL orbit of size 936, yielding stabilizer six.
